pages.text: Bearer curios are stronger than normal relics, and most come with a cost or a condition.$(br2)$(li)$(l)Reliquary$(): extra charm slots and sustain; Hunger if overloaded$(li)$(l)Chain$(): damage taken becomes bonus damage$(li)$(l)Eye$(): defense when still, speed when moving$(li)$(l)Censer$(): weakens nearby monsters, heals you$(li)$(l)Nail$(): rewards killing one marked target$(li)$(l)Mercy$(): ends Provocation at full attunement
